# Desert Paintings

> Small watercolors from Palm Springs and the surrounding desert. Original 4×6 and 5×7 watercolors by Mark, a painter in Palm Springs, California. All originals are currently available; inquiries go to mark.flournoy@gmail.com.

## Pages

- [Home](https://desertpaintings.com/): featured painting and the full index
- [Paintings](https://desertpaintings.com/paintings/): all paintings, numbered in the order they were made
- [About](https://desertpaintings.com/about/): about Mark, contact, and common questions
- [Videos](https://desertpaintings.com/videos/): painting videos on YouTube (@desertpaintings)

## What Mark is learning from

- Book: Start to Paint with Watercolours by Arnold Lowrey (Search Press)
- Book: The Laws Guide to Nature Drawing and Journaling by John Muir Laws (Heyday)
- YouTube: Bob Ross (https://www.youtube.com/@bobross_thejoyofpainting)
- YouTube: @learntopaintwatercolor (https://www.youtube.com/@learntopaintwatercolor)
